set(SPECTRA_PACK ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/data/spektrafilm.sfpk)

add_test(NAME pack_verify COMMAND spectra-cli pack-verify --pack ${SPECTRA_PACK})

# Parity suites: goldens generated by tools/parity/make_golden.py from the
# pinned Python reference.
file(GLOB PARITY_SUITES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/golden/*/cases.json)
foreach(cases ${PARITY_SUITES})
  get_filename_component(dir ${cases} DIRECTORY)
  get_filename_component(suite ${dir} NAME)
  add_test(NAME parity_${suite} COMMAND spectra-cli parity ${cases} --pack ${SPECTRA_PACK})
  set_tests_properties(parity_${suite} PROPERTIES LABELS "parity" TIMEOUT 1800)
endforeach()

add_executable(test_sanity test_sanity.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_sanity PRIVATE spectra_pipeline)
add_test(NAME sanity COMMAND test_sanity ${SPECTRA_PACK})
